name: ringringring-inbound
displayName: ringringring inbound: take and place phone calls
description: Incoming calls for ringringring: the user dials a SIP account from Linphone, the agent is woken by a channel event, answers, talks and hangs up; it can also dial the user back from the same account. Optional quiet listening, push-on-voice and an HTTPS remote MCP with OAuth. Requires the ringringring native install (pjsua2 + app code).
